description: Use when someone asks about a council's licensing schemes in England. Returns every scheme for the council with its wards, dates, fees and council sources. Pass a slug such as 'southwark' or a name such as 'Birmingham'. Read-only. A council we have not researched yet returns researched: false with its region and landlord register window.

council.description: Council slug or name, e.g. 'southwark' or 'Tower Hamlets'
